title: Notifications
empty: Nothing yet. Family activity you can see will show up here.
welcome_push_body: Homer here 🏡 This is how FamilyWell will tap you on the shoulder.
push_unsupported: This browser can't do push notifications.
push_install_ios: On iPhone, add FamilyWell to your Home Screen first (Share, then Add to Home Screen) and open it from there.
push_per_device: Push is per device: turn it on wherever you want alerts. What you're notified about applies everywhere.
muted_note: Turning one off stops the push. It still shows in your in-app notifications.
